# Efferd source used in the Sterlyn workspace

The staff workspace adapts the **free Dashboard 1** block's welcome header, divided three-column statistics and recent-record table composition. Its original demo invoices/revenue and static data are replaced with Sterlyn's live enquiries, assignments and order activity. The chart now uses Recharts, as in the original block, with responsive area fills, data transitions, accessible tooltips and period controls. Motion uses the already installed Motion library. No parallel application shell or business-data implementation is introduced.

- Registry source: https://efferd.com/r/new-york/dashboard-1.json
- Catalogue: https://efferd.com/blocks/dashboard
- License: https://efferd.com/license (reviewed 3 November 2026)

Efferd permits modification and use of its free blocks inside client products. This application is not a block library or redistribution of the standalone blocks. No paid block, registry token or Efferd demo imagery is used. The existing Sterlyn public-site identity remains unchanged.

The current refinement removes the large guide/email panels in favor of a compact queue and fulfilment summary. It adds keyboard/hover chart inspection, series toggles, period controls, guarded asynchronous refreshes and reduced-motion support. All production figures remain database-backed; screenshots from the chart acceptance test use clearly synthetic records in the isolated test database.
